purpose: Measure and improve capability per token, compute unit, and dollar while preserving verifiable behavior.

trace_inversion.scope: observable execution evidence and successful strategies
trace_inversion.private_hidden_reasoning_rule: Do not attempt to expose, reconstruct, or store a model's private chain-of-thought. Store only authorized observable actions, evidence, outcomes, and compact strategy abstractions.

distillation.objective: retain verified capability while reducing inference and learning token requirements
distillation.promotion_rule: A distilled artifact must match or exceed its configured retention threshold on held-out regression tests before promotion.

scale_rule: Never use a fixed model, bot, or module count as an architectural limit; scale according to available resources and verified registry capacity.
